html:
On 16 November 1776 the Dutch fort on Sint Eustatius fired a salute to the American ship Andrew Doria, the first time a foreign power recognised the flag of the new United States.

The tiny island, called the Golden Rock, was then one of the busiest ports in the Americas. As a free port it sold arms and gunpowder to the American rebels in the War of Independence, to Britain's fury.

In 1781 Admiral Rodney seized the island and looted its warehouses, ruining its trade, as part of the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War. It never recovered. Americans recall the salute each year, and the island is now a special municipality of the Netherlands.
sum: On 16 November 1776 the Dutch fort on Sint Eustatius fired a salute to the American ship Andrew Doria, the first time a foreign power recognised the flag of the new United States.
